title: Timetable, Tasks & Profile UI Streamlining
releaseNotes: Cleaned Up Timetable Toolbar: Removed redundant GPA subtab button in favor of the dedicated GPA page and streamlined action options into the More menu.
Simplified Tasks Tracker: Removed the focus timer card to focus directly on assignment tracking, due dates, and reminders.
Consolidated Campus Selection: Removed duplicate campus button from Profile card, keeping university selection cohesive inside Edit Profile.
